category_title: Proactive students who utilize modeling and mentor support to catch up
minimal_context: The student is working on a math problem on a whiteboard during an after-school tutoring session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Here is the next math problem for our after-school tutoring session.

STUDENT: Mr. Lopez keeps me on track, making sure I get to my math teacher whenever there is free time to help me catch up—he looks out [for me].

TUTOR: Go ahead and try to solve it.

STUDENT: (Writing the math problem on the whiteboards) I need to make sure I understand the content.

TUTOR: Our time is up for today, you need to pack up.

STUDENT: (Rewriting the math problem on the whiteboards) I can't go yet, I am rewriting the math problem on the whiteboards, making sure I understood the content before I left.

options.A: Sit and work one-on-one with the student at the whiteboard during the tutoring session.
options.B: Use specific praise that includes a description of the behavior (e.g., 'Great job on your math problem').
options.C: Intentionally withhold attention from the student while he is at the whiteboard during the session.
options.D: Deliver verbal statements or gestures (e.g., high five) indicating approval beyond simple acknowledgment.
